Description

2021 Topps Chrome was released August 20th. Each Hobby box will yield two autographs, ten inserts and 12 Refractors while each Jumbo box will have five autos and twelve Refractors.

New for 2021 were Hobby Lite boxes, which do not guarantee an autograph.

We estimate that around 79,000 Hobby boxes were produced, and increase of 39% over last year's product.

Distribution

Hobby: 24 packs per box, four cards per pack. 12 boxes per case.

Hobby Lite: 16 packs per box (MSRP: $100), four cards per pack. Exclusive to topps.com

Jumbo: 12 packs per box, 13 cards per pack. Eight boxes per case.
